6-7 (started 2-6, won 4 straight) with a poor passing offense (as-played OFF p17, PASS p9, RECV p1) but a decent run game + a middling defense (DEF p22). QB Lunch Winfield (a dual-threat) took over midseason and sparked the run to a bowl.

The OFFENSE keeps its dual-threat QB (Winfield) + its one proven playmaker (5-star WR Sampson) + a VETERAN OL (7 of 10 who started in an injury-plagued, 8-combination '25 return; PBLK was p23 but health should help - 'projects as a strength'). But BOTH proven RBs (Perry + Davis, 3,264 combined yds) transferred to the P4 - the backfield is Winfield's legs + a young/newcomer committee.

The DEFENSE lost 9 of its top 10 snap-count defenders (mostly GRADUATION): the DL's top graders (Lawson 77.1 + Crider/Whitfield/Baudoin/Miller, all yr4) are gone, and LB is a FULL RESET (the top 3 candidates have played almost exclusively on ST). BUT the secondary is a genuine strength - rising-star CB Brent Gordon (83.4, 11 PBU as a frosh) + S Maurion Eleam (74.0) + depth return; DL vet Fitzgerald West pulled out of the portal.

ST: returning K Tony Sterner (20-28); the punter is unsettled - '25 P Nathan Torney was a senior (yr4), no returning punter named by Athlon. SPEC-p51 unit. (Post-freeze fix: an earlier 'Mason Golding' punter name was fabricated - not in any feed - and the departure gate caught it.)
